summary: Centerra Gold furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 30, 2026 press release scheduling its third quarter 2026 operating and financial results for release after market close on October 29, 2026, with a conference call and webcast on October 30, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. No transaction, stakeholder, or corporate-action terms are stated. The filing is a routine earnings-timing notice with no board recommendation or advisor named, no mechanics or regulatory clock, and nothing for a risk-arbitrage angle to trade around.
